sloka: कौशिकी तीरम् आसाद्य तपः तेपे दुरासदम् ।तस्य वर्ष सहस्राणि घोरम् तप उपासतः ॥१-६३-१५॥
transliteration: kauśikī tīram āsādya tapaḥ tepe durāsadam ।tasya varṣa sahasrāṇi ghoram tapa upāsataḥ ॥1-63-15॥

translations.english: O Rama while he was performing rigorous penance for a thousand years on the northern mountains, the gods were gripped with fear. (lest he should exceed them).
